items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: there was a piano player named Harvey Brooks and Lawrence used to take his trombone and go around to the tables and play tunes.

ctx.x: Yeah. I never heard nothing that fast. I never heard a trombone player like that, not like Lawrence was playing in those days. Now, when I met him in Sebastian's Cotton Club, he was working with Les Hite. Now, in between dance sets of the show, there was a piano player named Harvey Brooks and Lawrence used to take his trombone and go around to the tables and play tunes. Whatever tune that the people wanted to hear Lawrence would play a tune for them. He could play that soft.
